paragraphs: Art. 47. (1) In the cases under Art. 66(2) ЗМИП, when the persons under Art. 4 of that Act clarify the origin of the funds by a written declaration of the client, of the client's legal representative or of an agent, the declaration must contain the particulars of Appendix No. 4.

(2) The declaration under para. 1 may be part of another document that comes from the declarant, but it must contain all particulars of Appendix No. 4 and must raise no doubt about the person who gives it or about its content.
(3) The declaration under para. 1 is given before the person under Art. 4 ЗМИП, or before an employee designated by that person, before the operation or the deal.
(4) The persons under Art. 4 ЗМИП do not accept the origin of the funds as clarified if the declaration under para. 1 is not filled in, signed and given under paras. 1–3.

Art. 64. (1) The Supreme Bar Council, the Notary Chamber, the Chamber of Private Enforcement Agents and the Institute of Certified Public Accountants reflect in the uniform internal rules under Art. 101(4) ЗМИП the risk assessments made under Art. 100 ЗМИП or, if there are none, the relevant conclusions of the supranational risk assessment of the European Commission and the risk assessment under Art. 95 ЗМИП.

(2) Within 7 days of their adoption, the uniform internal rules are published on the websites of the Supreme Bar Council, the Notary Chamber, the Chamber of Private Enforcement Agents, the Institute of Certified Public Accountants and the State Agency for National Security.

(3) Within 14 days of the publication under para. 2, the members of the Notary Chamber, of the Chamber of Private Enforcement Agents and of the Institute of Certified Public Accountants give a declaration to their chamber or institute. (Partly repealed by decisions of the Supreme Administrative Court, SG No. 61 of 2025, as far as it concerned the members of the bar.)
(4) Newly admitted members give the declarations under para. 3 within 14 days of their admission; attorneys, within 14 days of their entry.

(5) The Notary Chamber, the Chamber of Private Enforcement Agents and the Institute of Certified Public Accountants give the Financial Intelligence Directorate of the State Agency for National Security current information on their members; the Supreme Bar Council gives current information on the members of the bars.

(6) The information under para. 5 is given on a form approved by the director of the Financial Intelligence Directorate and published on the website of the State Agency for National Security, by 31 January of the year after the year to which it refers.

Art. 67. (1) The persons under Art. 4 ЗМИП prepare every year a plan of initial and continuing training of their employees on the requirements of ЗМИП, ЗМФТ and the acts for their application. The plan also includes current practical training on recognising suspicious operations, deals and clients and on the steps to take when a doubt of money laundering or terrorist financing arises.

(2) In the on-site inspections under Art. 108(3) and (8) ЗМИП, the persons under Art. 4 ЗМИП give the control bodies under Art. 108(2) of that Act the plans under para. 1 and the reports on their performance.
